programmes.show_description: Our Finest Hour - Part 1: Newscaster Clete Roberts returns to interview the members of the 4077th for an update on the war conditions from the perspectives of those enduring it every day.
Our Finest Hour - Part 2: Hawkeye reveals his sensitive side, a departure from his generally humorous persona, during the Clete Roberts interviews.
The Billfold Syndrome: Major Charles Winchester refuses to talk to anyone in the unit when he is denied a future medical position back in Boston. Hawkeye and BJ goad him mercilessly.
Thought for the Day: Matthew is delighted when Henry agrees to allow a young lodger to move in. However, his delight is soon dampened when he learns their new housemate is a local curate.
Rumpole and the Judge's Elbow: Rumpole defends the owner of a chain of massage parlours charged with running disorderly houses.
An uplifting round-up of good news stories from the UK and around the world.
A Special Love: Part 2: Scotty and Diane are determined to adopt Todd, but Todd's parents won't agree. Both sides are prepared to fight it out in court.
An uplifting round-up of good news stories from the UK and around the world.
For The Love Of Larry: A precocious dog tries to lead Jonathan and Mark to his owners who are trapped in a car at the bottom of a hill.
An uplifting round-up of good news stories from the UK and around the world.

Bless the Boy in Blue: Mark asks God to make Jonathan a police officer for a while. After 40 years, Jonathan becomes human only to realise the harsh realities of being a cop.
Cindy: An aspiring actress wants to be accepted for who she really is, not in the image her well-meaning dad tries to transform her into.
The Wolves: Laura and Andy find what they believe to be a stray dog caught in a trap with her two pups nearby.
The Creeper of Walnut Grove: Inspired by a fictional Scotland Yard detective, Andy and Laura attempt to bring the mysterious Walnut Grove chicken thief to justice.
To Run and Hide: Holding himself responsible for a friend's death and unable to face the man's heavily pregnant widow, a disheartened Doc Baker leaves Walnut Grove.
The Empty Nest: Part 1: The family mourns Grandpa's death. Meanwhile, Mary Ellen and Erin become roommates in Charlottesville. Part 1 of 2.
The Empty Nest: Part 2: The family mourns Grandpa's death. Meanwhile, Mary Ellen and Erin become roommates in Charlottesville. Part 2 of 2.
The Cat and Daddy G.: Father Sheahan hears an interesting confession. Grainne's pet goat suddenly becomes indispensable after meeting Avril's horse.
In at the Deep End: While the Addis family busy themselves adjusting to their new country lifestyle, they neglect to notice that something is troubling their youngest daughter, Molly.
The Overnight Stay: During an intense 24-hour heatwave in the middle of London, temperatures and passions rise, whilst the Thrift copes with exhausted casualties from the local brewery.
An uplifting round-up of good news stories from the UK and around the world.
Rumpole and the Bright Seraphim: Rumpole heads to Germany to represent a British soldier court martialled for the murder of a regimental sergeant.
None Like it Hot: Another heatwave has hit and it's affecting everyone, especially Klinger. As a result of the heat, he has come up with one of his most ingenious discharge schemes to date.
They Call the Wind Korea: A windstorm hits and everyone is busy securing items. Klinger and Major Winchester encounter an overturned truck with four wounded Greek soldiers inside.
Major Ego: Charles dramatically revives a dying patient, becoming even more insufferable than ever when a photo journalist from Stars and Stripes arrives to publicise the story.

Birds Of A Feather: Factory workers ignore ground-water contamination, even though it is making their children sick. Jonathan resorts to drastic measures to force them to face the facts.
The High Cost of Being Right: After the Garveys' grain-filled barn burns down and leaves them with nothing, proud Jonathan refuses to accept help from anyone, including his wife Alice.
The Fighter: An ageing boxer who has sacrificed his family life and his health for his career meets his match in the ring in Walnut Grove.
The Calling: Jim-Bob falls in love with a young woman who is struggling to decide whether to train as a nun.
The Moonshiner: Jason takes responsibility for cousin Boone after he breaks the law. Meanwhile, Daisy comes back for a visit.
Spirit Proof: The ghost of a highwayman returns to haunt the village after Dooley finds some ancient fishing rights. Kathleen causes havoc as she learns to drive.
O Best Beloved...: Marcus has a job interview, and he gives Brian a business plan to take to the bank. Faith suddenly finds that Sarah is missing. Marcus gets the job.

Rumpole's Last Case: Rumpole defends another member of the Timson family during a burglary case. But is his mind on other things?
Baby, it's Cold Outside: Charles becomes the most unpopular man in camp when he flaunts a polar suit sent from his parents while everyone suffers during the extreme weather conditions.
Point of View: The surroundings at the 4077th are seen through the eyes of a wounded soldier in this unique episode.
Dear Comrade: Charles seems unusually smug and content lately. Hawkeye and BJ discover it is due to the meticulous care he is receiving from his newly hired, menially paid Korean servant.
